mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reward_claim WHERE user_reward_id IN (SELECT user_reward_id FROM user_reward WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward_claim (user_reward_id, recipient_name, phone, address, memo) VALUES (#{userRewardId}, #{recipientName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{memo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recipient_name = #{recipientName}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, memo = #{memo}
